questions.question: What did God do when Hezekiah prayed during his deadly illness?
options: Added fifteen years to his life
Restored his lost kingdom to him
Sent a prophet to anoint his son
Made the sun stand still for a day
questions.answer: Added fifteen years to his life

questions.question: What sign did God give Hezekiah?
options: The shadow went back ten steps on the stairway
A great rainbow appeared over the whole city
A bright and blazing star fell from the sky
A violent earthquake shook the whole temple of God
questions.answer: The shadow went back ten steps on the stairway

questions.question: Hezekiah unwisely showed all his treasures to envoys from Babylon.
God added _____ years to Hezekiah's life after he prayed.
As a sign, the _____ went backward ten steps on the stairway of Ahaz.
